_extraction_flags.notes: Microwave Photonics ISAC. W-band (97.5 GHz) wireless link generated and processed using photonics (Fiber-Wireless). Not FSO/VLC, but 'Optical-Assisted RF ISAC'. Included based on user list.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1/3: Setup shows Laser -> MZM -> Fiber -> PD -> Antenna (97.5 GHz Radiation). Fig 2: Concept of Fiber-Wireless Network. Fig 16/17: Multi-target detection proving elimination of 'False Targets'.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: W-band ISAC (97.5 GHz). Generation: Photonic (Optical Frequency Comb/Heterodyne). Problem: Square-law detection in PD/ED causes mixing of echoes -> False Targets. Solution: Balanced PD (BPD), HPF, and MZM bias optimization.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 15-60 Gbps (SCM/QAM). Sensing: 1.76-3.15 cm resolution. Range Error < 3cm.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Solid experimental work addressing a specific implementation issue (False Targets) in Microwave Photonic ISAC. Good integration of Fiber and Wireless segments.

bibliographic.title: Photonic-Based Flexible Integrated Sensing and Communication With Multiple Targets Detection Capability for W-Band Fiber-Wireless Network
bibliographic.authors: Boyu Dong, Junlian Jia, Zhongya Li, Guoqiang Li, Jianyang Shi, Haipeng Wang, Nan Chi, Junwen Zhang
bibliographic.venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

application.scenario_description: Centralized processing (CO) connected via fiber to Remote Radio Units (RRU) emitting W-band ISAC signals.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Identification and mitigation of 'False Target' generation in Photonic ISAC due to non-linear mixing. Proposed solution uses BPD, HPF, and optimized MZM bias.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: False phantom targets appearing in multi-target scenarios in Microwave Photonic Radars.

transmitter.notes: Laser source used to generate 97.5 GHz RF. 12 GHz total bandwidth.

receiver.notes: Balanced Photodiode (BPD) used to suppress common-mode noise and mixing products.

integration.notes: FDM of SCM (Comm) and LFM (Sensing) signals.

tradeoff.notes: Power/Bandwidth allocation between SCM and LFM bands trades off Comm Rate vs Sensing Resolution.
